_numbering_note: catalog_number pending the base/hybrid renumbering (was the v1 Ptolan; csv_id is authoritative).
sub_palette: classical (hellenic) backbone + near_eastern (egyptian) overlay (cross-family blend, Hellenic-leaning)

blend.backbone: hellenic (classical: the Greek court-register, the polis-magistracy and the Basileus ladder, -os/-on/-eus endings, aspirates th/ph/kh, patronymic -ides, pitch/root stress)
blend.overlay: near_eastern (egyptian: the Nile-and-temple substrate, the Per-/Niut- construct toponyms, the funerary and god-king cult, dj/tj/kh touches and -aa/-et roots beneath the Greek surface)
blend.lean: Hellenic-heavy - a Greek (Hellenic) dynasty enthroned over an Egyptian temple-society (the Ptolemies): the Greek court and phonology rule and supply the prestige register, the Egyptian temple-land endures and serves beneath, lending the Nile, temple and funerary words. This is the one Egyptian-pairing kit that leans the Greek partner, for historical reasons.

_note: Cross-family hybrid under the base/hybrid model. BASE_05 Abydosian (Egyptian) x BASE_07 Achillean (Hellenic Greek), Hellenic-leaning. Concept: a Greek (Hellenic) dynasty ruling over an Egyptian temple-society - a Ptolemaic realm; the Greek court enthroned over the Nile land, the two cults fused in the temple (a Serapis-style syncretism). Backbone/prestige = Hellenic (classical: the court-register, the polis-magistracy, the Basileus ladder, the Greek phonology); overlay/substrate = Egyptian (the Nile-and-temple land, the Per-/Niut- toponyms, the funerary cult, the priestly populace). CIV/CLAN: both parents Civilized -> Civ (feudal). Common-word lexicon is now a SINGLE FUSED tongue (Greek-lean) per gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md; rank titles use ENGLISH display with the real Greek register in ruler_native (allowed, catalog 5.3). APPROVED FOREIGN DISPLAY TERMS: the realm styles its county magistrate Archon (the Greek polis-magistrate) and its crown Pharaoh (the Ptolemies styled themselves Pharaoh - the realm's iconic throne). DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon from both parents (Hellenic reflexes primary, Egyptian variants secondary), never real Greek/Egyptian gods. All human cultures allow Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic. [REWORKED 2026-06-28 to base/hybrid model: csv_id HYB_35; Hellenic-lean PRESERVED (Ptolemaic Egypt); all-three alignment; English display titles + Greek ruler_native; deep-fusion lexicon + fusion_rules.]

phonology.palette: Hellenic (classical) backbone - a e i o u with long e/o, aspirates th/ph/kh, the endings -os/-on/-es/-eus/-a, patronymic -id-, pitch and root stress, Greek onset clusters - meeting an Egyptian overlay: the dj/tj/kh consonant-touches, the long -aa and -et substrate roots, the Per-/Niut- construct toponyms. The Greek surface dominates: every inherited root, Greek or Egyptian, is run through Hellenic phonology and given a Greek ending. Theophoric on the Hellenic reflexes (Tulrios-, Numenos-) with Egyptian construct variants (Tjuraa-, Riaret-).
phonology.phonotactics: CV / CVC; Greek clusters kt/pt/st/ph/th/kh/ps with vowel-final preferred; the Egyptian overlay contributes dj/tj and long -aa beneath, but the surface takes the Greek -os/-on/-a; Hellenic root/pitch stress over the Per-/Niut- construct toponyms.

sound_changes: Egyptian dj/tj/kh adapted to the Greek inventory: dj>z or d, tj>t or s, kh>kh (retained, the one shared aspirate), q>k
Egyptian -aa/-et substrate endings recut to Greek: final -aa>-a/-os, -et>-e/-is, bare-consonant roots take a Greek -os/-on; mimation/construct vowels drop
Hellenic root and pitch stress on all words; Greek onset clusters (st, pt, kt, ph, th, ps) permitted; open vowel-final preferred
retain the Greek aspirates th/ph/kh and the Egyptian dj/sh as audible signature phonemes of each ancestry; very short Egyptian roots take a Greek -os/-on/-a
fusion_rules.source_tilt: Nile / temple / funerary / material and staple words from Egyptian roots (the temple-land substrate: itru, per-netjer, deshret, senetjer, nebu); rule / kin-line / court / civic / quality / learned words from Greek roots (the ruling court-register: polis, oikos, huios, megas, basileia); every root then run through the one Greek-shaped sound-law so the split is invisible at the surface

lexicon._note: Single fused tongue derived via phonology.fusion_rules (gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md): Egyptian Nile/temple/funerary/material roots + Greek rule/kin/court/civic roots, all run through one Hellenic-shaped sound-law (-os/-on/-a endings, Greek clusters, pitch stress); portmanteaus mark the temple-land institutions and the blended bloodline. Greek-lean: the surface sounds Hellenic, Egyptian-substrated beneath.

morphology.patronymic_form: patronymic -ides / -ou (son of) + polis demonym; the Egyptian substrate keeps filiation sa-X; the royal house traces the Ptole- dynastic line.
morphology.compounding_rule: [adjective|resource](stem) + feature with linking -o-; Nea-Polis (new-city); the Egyptian overlay yields Per-[god] and Niut-[god].

title_ladder.government: feudal (a Hellenistic kingdom over an Egyptian land: the Greek court styled Pharaoh to the native temples, wearing the double crown; the Greek polis-magistracy - the Archon - over the Egyptian nome-substrate)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Hellenic backbone, ascending, with an Egyptian overlay at the nome and the crown. DISPLAY titles are English except two approved foreign terms: Archon (the Greek polis-magistrate) at county, and Pharaoh at kingdom (the Ptolemies styled themselves Pharaoh - the realm's iconic throne). ruler_native carries the full Greek register: Toparch barony; Phrourarch (garrison-commander) march; Nomarch (governor of an Egyptian nome) county; Strategos (general-governor) duchy; Dynastes (prince) principality; Basileus (king) kingdom; Basileus Megas, styled Per-aa (Pharaoh) to the native temples, empire. The Greek court and the Egyptian priesthood share the rule. (Rank titles are the real Greek/Egyptian register, allowed.)
title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler'). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: Greek personal + patronymic (-ides) + polis demonym for the court; the Egyptian substrate keeps theophoric given + filiation (sa-X); the royal line the Ptole- dynastic name.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the Greek court uses Hellenic names; the Egyptian commons keep theophoric Egyptian names.
people_name_convention.theophoric: Greek names invoke the powers' domains (-machos for war, Sopho- for wisdom); the Egyptian substrate uses X-hotep (X-is-content) on the morphed stems. e.g. Tulrio-doros, Tjuraa-hotep.

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon (Hellenic reflexes primary, from classical theonym treatment; Egyptian variants secondary, from near_eastern theonym_sets), never real Greek/Egyptian gods. The Ptolan fuse the two cults (a Serapis-style syncretism): each power has a Hellenic court-name and an Egyptian temple-name, held to be one. Ptolan stance follows its CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment). The polis-temple and the Egyptian Per-netjer keep the rites together.
religion.the_one: Aiternos (< Aeternus; Egyptian temple-name Atjernaa) - the One, revered as the Most High when Lawful, acknowledged but set aside when Neutral, defied as the tyrant-god when Chaotic

sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Tulrios (Egy. Tjuraa) - sun and right-order; Lawful
sample_deity_renames.Maraxus: Maraxos (Egy. Marakhu) - the war-fire; Chaotic, demonized

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: revere the One (Aiternos/Atjernaa) and the Lawful powers (Tulrios, Orlandros, Numenos, Gauandos), demonize the Chaotic powers
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: all powers ambivalent; foreground the deified ancestors (the justified dead) and the local temple-cults of place
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: venerate the Chaotic powers of the canon (Maraxos/Marakhu and their kin), and name the Lawful powers - and the One - as the tyrant-gods to be defied

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the demonized set (the Chaotic powers, when Lawful) take dread epithets: Maraxus -> Maraxos the Tyrant-Flame (Egy. Marakhu the City-Burner); Vacidus -> Wakedjet the Devourer; Lusanto -> Lusandros the Coin-Serpent.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Temenos (sacred precinct) or Per-netjer (god's-house) of [power]: 'the Temenos of Tulrios', 'the Per-netjer of Tjuraa'.
religion.saints_pattern: deified kings and founder-heroes (Greek Heros [name]; Egyptian the justified dead, maa-kheru), venerated at the temple and the royal tomb.

holy_symbol_motifs.Realta: a sheltering mother-goddess over the lotus
holy_symbol_motifs.Aiternos: the winged disc above the polis-eagle
